value_kinds.name: document-docx
value_kinds.description: One Office Open XML text document, produced by the worker and returned as bytes.

value_kinds.name: json-utf8
value_kinds.description: One bounded UTF-8 JSON document whose shape the entrypoint's own reader fixes. It names no file, no origin and no handle.

value_kinds.name: spreadsheet-xlsx
value_kinds.description: One Office Open XML workbook, produced by the worker and returned as bytes. Nothing is written to a disk the worker can see, because it can see none.

value_kinds.name: table-csv-utf8
value_kinds.description: Bounded UTF-8 comma-separated rows with a header row. The bytes are data, never a formula and never a reference to another cell.

native_paths.description: Selecting, ordering, grouping and pivoting rows is arithmetic over a bounded table. The portable core owns it, in Rust, in a process that already exists and that a person's data already crosses.

entrypoints.summary: Compose one text document from a described outline and return its bytes.

inputs.name: document
inputs.description: The described document: its sections, their headings and their paragraphs.

entrypoints.summary: Compose one workbook from tables and a described layout, and return its bytes.

inputs.name: workbook
inputs.description: The described workbook: its sheets, their column headings and their formats.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: The cell values, already reshaped, one table per named sheet.

entrypoints.summary: Select, order, group and pivot the rows of one bounded table.

inputs.name: recipe
inputs.description: The described reshaping: which columns survive, in what order, grouped by what.
